segments.sn3.23:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho rājā pasenadi kosalo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn3.23:1.3: “kati nu kho, bhante, lokassa dhammā uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāyā”ti?
segments.sn3.23:1.4: “Tayo kho, mahārāja, lokassa dhammā uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.sn3.23:1.6: Lobho kho, mahārāja, lokassa dhammo, uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.sn3.23:1.7: Doso kho, mahārāja, lokassa dhammo, uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.sn3.23:1.8: Moho kho, mahārāja, lokassa dhammo, uppajjamāno uppajjati ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāya.
segments.sn3.23:1.9: Ime kho, mahārāja, tayo lokassa dhammā uppajjamānā uppajjanti ahitāya dukkhāya aphāsuvihārāyā”ti.

after.title: Issattasuttavaṇṇanā
lines: Bhagavato kira paṭhamabodhiyaṃ mahālābhasakkāro udapādi bhikkhusaṅghassa ca.
Titthiyā hatalābhasakkārā hutvā kulesu evaṃ kanthentā vicaranti –
“samaṇo gotamo evamāha,‘mayhameva dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ.
Mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dānaṃ dātabbaṃ.
Mayhameva dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ.
Mayhameva sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalaṃ, na aññesaṃ sāvakānaṃ dinnaṃ mahapphalan’ti.
Yuttaṃ nu kho sayampi bhikkhācāranissitena paresaṃ bhikkhācāranissitānaṃ catunnaṃ paccayānaṃ antarāyaṃ kātuṃ, ayuttaṃ karoti ananucchavikan”ti.

Sacāhaṃ idheva ṭhatvā ‘mā evaṃ avocuttha, na satthā evaṃ kathetī’ti vadeyyaṃ, evaṃ sā kathā nijjhattiṃ na gaccheyya, imassa mahājanassa sannipatitakāleyeva naṃ nijjhāpessāmī”ti ekaṃ chaṇadivasaṃ āgamento tuṇhī ahosi.
